seo.title: Dublin — Homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Dublin: Verified shelter, food, health and social-support contacts for people experiencing homelessness.

page.heading: Dublin — Homeless help
page.urgent: Immediate danger or medical emergency: call 911 or the local emergency number.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call ahead when possible.

entries.title: Dublin Region Homeless Executive Freephone
entries.description: Call if you need emergency accommodation. Staff assess your situation and available options; a call does not guarantee a bed. State clearly if you have children or are at immediate risk.
entries.hours: Daily; check the current hours on Homeless Dublin

entries.title: Central Placement Service
entries.description: The central access point for emergency accommodation in Dublin. Bring identification if available, but still ask for help if documents are missing.
entries.how_to_access: Call the Freephone before travelling and ask where to present that day.

entries.title: Dublin Simon emergency shelter
entries.description: Emergency beds for single adults and couples are accessed through the Central Placement Service, not guaranteed by arriving directly at the shelter.
entries.how_to_access: Ask the Central Placement Service about Harcourt Street or Carman's Hall and current availability.

entries.title: Homeless day services
entries.description: Official local guidance lists day centres for food, showers, laundry, health, phone charging and housing support. Services and opening times vary.
entries.how_to_access: Use the current list to choose a suitable centre and call first where possible.

entries.title: Threshold housing advice
entries.description: Free advice for renters at risk of losing their home, including notices, rent problems and tenancy rights. It is not an emergency shelter service.
entries.hours: Monday to Friday; check current telephone hours
